propositions: A read-only metrics reader must derive cost proxies (llm_calls, latency) exclusively from plan_review_result_v2 REVIEW_RESULT.metrics blocks, never from COMPLETION_VERDICT records which carry no metrics.

Cost-per-accepted-change is computed as summed llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records (accepted closes), returning None when no accepted closes exist to avoid division by zero.

First-pass-verification fraction is determined by scanning the earliest (oldest-first by filename order) COMPLETION_VERDICT record per ticket and counting those whose first verdict is completion_verifier_pass_v1.

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next PASS record matching the same gate field (plan_review, code_review, or completion), computing interval as PASS timestamp minus ERROR timestamp; an ERROR with no following same-gate PASS remains an open interval.

The reader performs a single raw ordered scan per ticket of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files sorted by ns-epoch filename prefix, reading schema and verdict from event data without using reducer-level schema helpers.
All metrics register into src/rebar/metrics/registry.py with source='sidecar' and confidence='high' (authoritative), with no writes to underlying storage.
